title: Microsoft Teams: tenant meeting policy for who can start recording and transcription
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned tenant policy from existing recording controls and leaves the new policy's default and licensing unpublished. The sensitivity-label navigation should include the scope-selection page; its required selections are already correctly given in the note.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a Teams meeting policy controlling who can start recording and transcription.
claims.quote: Teams administrators can use meeting policies to control who can start recording and transcription, helping organizations apply consistent meeting settings.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The planned policy can restrict recording and transcription permissions to organisers and co-organisers.
claims.quote: Administrators can restrict these permissions to organizers and co-organizers or extend them to presenters.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope: Who is affected
claims.claim: The planned policy can extend recording and transcription permissions to presenters.
claims.quote: Administrators can restrict these permissions to organizers and co-organizers or extend them to presenters.

claims.claim: Administrators can allow meeting organisers to modify the planned setting.
claims.quote: They can also determine whether meeting organizers can modify these settings or whether they are enforced by policy.

claims.claim: Administrators can enforce the planned setting instead of permitting organiser changes.
claims.quote: They can also determine whether meeting organizers can modify these settings or whether they are enforced by policy.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Existing meeting options let the organiser choose organisers and co-organisers, or organisers, co-organisers and presenters.
claims.quote:
Organizers with a Teams Premium license have two options for who can record and transcribe a meeting:
- Organizers and co-organizers
- Organizers, co-organizers, and presenters

The meeting organizer normally makes this choice when they create the meeting.

claims.claim: A meeting template can enforce who can record or allow the organiser to change that setting.
claims.quote: If not controlled by a sensitivity label, selects a setting of Organizers and co-organizers or Organizers, co-organizers, and presenters. Setting can be enforced or meeting organizer can be allowed to change.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; controls[4].governs
claims.claim: A sensitivity label can enforce who can record and transcribe a meeting.
claims.quote: We also restrict recording to organizer and co-organizers by using the sensitivity label.

claims.claim: Learn states that there is no existing admin policy for Who can record.
claims.quote: Meeting recording can be disabled completely using a meeting policy, but there's no admin policy for Who can record.

claims.claim: The existing recording policy can disable recording entirely for the specified people or groups.
claims.quote: If you need to prevent meetings and events from being recorded entirely, you must use the recording policies in the Teams admin center. This setting applies to the people or groups that you specify

claims.claim: The setting that prevents recording entirely cannot be applied through a template or sensitivity label.
claims.quote: This setting applies to the people or groups that you specify, but can't be applied through a meeting template or sensitivity label.

claims.claim: Under the existing recording policy, the organiser needs recording permission.
claims.quote: Both the organizer and recording initiator need to have recording permissions to record the meeting or event.

claims.claim: Under the existing recording policy, the recording initiator also needs recording permission.
claims.quote: Both the organizer and recording initiator need to have recording permissions to record the meeting or event.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes permissions to start recording and transcription, not autonomous initiation.
claims.quote: Teams administrators can use meeting policies to control who can start recording and transcription

claims.claim: Meeting recording is configured in Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting recording.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select an existing policy or create a new one. ... Turn the Meeting recording toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowCloudRecording $true enables recording for that meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowCloudRecording $true

claims.claim: Transcription is configured in Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. ... Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription for that meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: Transcription is a per-organiser setting and must be enabled for the organiser.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting. For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: Transcription is also a per-user setting and must be enabled for the user who starts the recording or transcript.
claims.quote: The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: The template control is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting templates > Add > Recording & transcription > Who can record.
claims.quote:
In the Teams admin center, expand Meetings and select Meeting templates.
2. Select Add.
Recording & transcription
Who can record | Specifies whether meetings can be recorded by organizers and co-organizers only or by organizers, co-organizers, and presenters.
